image_description: A high-angle, symmetrical view of a church interior featuring a central stone altar. The altar is a raised rectangular structure with a white cloth covering the top surface and a wooden base. Behind it stands an ornate reredos with religious statues and a large stained-glass window above. Wooden pews line the aisle leading to the altar.
